title: DEMO: Novel agent vs methimazole in newly diagnosed Graves disease
brief_summary: FICTIONAL demo trial for pipeline testing. Not a real study.
eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18 to 65 years
* Clinical diagnosis of Graves' disease
* Free T4 above the upper limit of normal (> 1.8 ng/dL) within 30 days before enrollment
* Positive TSH receptor antibody (TRAb)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant or breastfeeding
* Prior radioactive iodine therapy
* ANC < 1.5 x 10^9/L within 30 days before enrollment

title: DEMO: First-line chemo-immunotherapy in advanced NSCLC
brief_summary: FICTIONAL demo trial for pipeline testing. Not a real study.
eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age >= 18 years
* Histologically confirmed non-small cell lung cancer
* ECOG performance status <= 1
* ANC >= 1.5 x 10^9/L within 14 days before enrollment

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous immunotherapy (anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1 or anti-CTLA-4)
* Active CNS metastases
* Chemotherapy within 28 days before enrollment
